# M5 Studio Miami · Venetian plaster and mineral wall finishes

> M5 Studio Miami is a Venetian plaster and mineral wall-finish studio in Miami, Florida. 13 own mineral materials (Venetian, Marmorino, Travertine, Concrete, Silk, Silk White, Velvet, Velvet Matte, Velvet White, Crystal, Crystal Shine, Exotic, Las Vegas), 27 hand-applied finishes, any color to order. Applied by our own master (15 years in the trade, the last 3 in the U.S.). Interior design and renovation as a second line, built with licensed & insured Florida contractor partners. Languages: English, Spanish, Ukrainian.

## What M5 does

- Venetian plaster, Marmorino, travertine, concrete-effect and other mineral plaster finishes for walls, ceilings, fireplaces, bathrooms and powder rooms, façades. Projects from $10,000. Fixed written price after a free site visit.
- Sample: a real hand-made sample of the chosen material and shade within 48 hours, free.
- Interior design and 3D; condo and villa renovation from $150,000. Designed by M5 and built with licensed & insured Florida contractor partners.

## Key facts

- Plaster projects start at $10,000; the exact price depends on material, area and substrate and is fixed in writing before work starts.
- Timeline: sample 48 h; accent wall 2–3 days on site; a full room about a week.
- Mineral plaster is breathable, washable and repairable; wet zones are sealed; suitable for Miami humidity and air conditioning.
- Condo work: condo hours, elevator booking, certificate of insurance, dust control.
- Showroom: Miami Ironside, 7636 NE 4th Ct #111, Miami, FL 33138. Opening November 2026, visits by appointment.
- Service area: Miami and Miami-Dade; façade work across Florida.
